Introduction

Kim Hyun-joon, better known as Tabber, is a South Korean alternative rapper and singer who debuted under You.will.knovv.

Tabber first gained attention on YouTube with ‘3AM Freestyle’. Prior to his official debut, he worked with artists such as Punchnello, DEAN and APRO, which contributed to his notoriety within the industry.

Tabber reached out to DEAN after hearing the latter’s 2015 single ‘Here & Now’. This led to his record deal with You.will.knovv.

On August 13, 2020, Tabber released his debut project “Deep End Mixtape, which was well-received. His second EP ‘Madness Always Turns to Sadness’ came in 2023.

In 2021, Tabber participated in season 10 of Show Me the Money, finishing eleventh. His appearance on the show captivated the producers due to his unique musicality. Tabber also participated in the HIPHOPLE compilation album ‘The:Rise Season 4’ alongside Northfacegawd, EXN, Oygli and Kwon Ki-baek.
